item.title: Version 5.4.0
item.description:
What's New in 5.4.0

Teacher 360Â° Executive Dossier

  • Full interactive faculty profile dialog with teaching allocations, weekly timetable, attendance log, payroll slips, quality walkthrough reviews, and issued certificates.
  • 1-Click actions for direct salary collection and quick profile editing.
  • Unified responsive TabBar geometry, typography, and divider styling matching the Student Dossier.

Dashboard Omni-Search & Floating Quick Dossier

  • Unified app bar search with instant multi-category filtering across ALL, STUDENTS, and STAFF.
  • Timer-less overlay focus stability ensuring the results menu remains mounted during press/hold, scrolling, and category switching.
  • Translucent backdrop barrier for responsive outside click dismissal.

Student Promotion & Session Rollover Subsystem

  • 3-Step interactive class promotion wizard with bulk pass selection, automatic roll number re-ranking, and new fee previews.
  • Whole-school progression matrix and immutable audit history ledger.
  • 1-Click atomic batch rollback restoring prior classroom, roll numbers, fees, and transport assignments.
  • Cascading double-promotion guard and sibling concession rollover.
  • Terminal class graduation into archived alumni cohort batches.

Collegiate AI Assistant Tools & Generative UI

  • Domain AI tools: cash flow queries, expense/income recording, transport fleet assignment, and multi-signal at-risk student triage.
  • Staged write proposals requiring explicit user confirmation before executing changes.
  • Generative UI deep-link action pills and inline 1-click PDF download cards.

Data Integrity & Performance Optimizations

  • Guaranteed Isar link eager-loading and safe unlinking across school structure and subject allocations.
  • Cascade cleanup of orphan records on classroom and subject deletions.
  • Background isolate PDF compilation (runPdfIsolate) preventing UI freezes during heavy export generation.
  • Multi-filter fee and payroll ledgers allowing simultaneous Class, Billing Month, and Status filtering.
  • Normalized date range interval boundaries to 23:59:59.999 preventing next-month transaction leakage.
